description: This file declares the interface for the DobbyContainer management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for container lifecycle operations (start, stop, pause, resume, etc.), information retrieval (list, info, state), annotation, mount, unmount, and event callbacks related to container state changes. It also manages internal dependencies such as DobbyProxy, OMI proxy, and IPC services.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class providing an interface to manage Docker-like containers via Dobby, including lifecycle, configuration, and event management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DobbyInterface with an event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the DobbyInterface.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current containers.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific container by ID.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container based on a Dobby specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a container, optionally forcing the stop.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container with options.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command in the specified container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds a key-value annotation to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation key from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a source directory or device into a container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a target from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback for container start event.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback for container stop event.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Callback for container state change event.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Callback for verification failure.

ctags.name: mEventListenerId
ctags.pattern: /^            int mEventListenerId; \/\/ Dobby event listener ID$/
